title: terminal.shellEvent (Agent -> Plugin)
description: Shell integration events produced by the Agent's port of rust-servers/src/pty/osc_scanner.rs. The payload is shape-identical to Termy's local ShellEvent so the plugin can forward it to the existing handler unchanged. cwd is deliberately absent: the plugin derives it by parsing the xterm buffer (extractCwdFromPromptLines), and the terminal output bytes that parsing needs are forwarded verbatim, so cwd tracking already works in remote mode without protocol support.
